entities.name: Bacterial uL13 (A0JZ27)
observations: The supplied 147-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt A0JZ27 (Arthrobacter sp. FB24) over its full length.
Annotated as a large ribosomal subunit protein and early 50S assembly protein; reference annotation says it is not observed to bind rRNA by itself.
Sequence-derived: 16,182.5 Da; pI 9.84; predicted charge at pH 7 +8.03; GRAVY −0.355.
No explicit catalytic reaction was retrieved; this is consistent with a ribosomal structural/assembly role, but alone does not establish absence of other activity.
